seo.title: Commission a piece
seo.description: Commission custom textile art from Nuaj Studio: handmade wall pieces and installations for homes, hotels, offices and public spaces — made from your idea, and sometimes your own fabric.

label: Commissions
question: Where does your piece begin?
title: Commission
a project
intro: A piece made for one place and the people who live with it — designed around your idea, your room and, if you like, fabric that already means something to you.

steps.title: Tell me your idea
steps.text: Share what you have in mind and any fabrics you'd like to use.

steps.title: I send a quote
steps.text: You'll get a design idea, a price, and a timeline.

steps.title: I make your piece
steps.text: I'll keep you updated, then deliver it to you.

imageAlt: A finished commissioned piece hanging in afternoon light
